name: RE-00 Lead Capture -> WhatsApp Buttons -> Site Visit (localhost)

parameters.content:
## 1. LEAD CAPTURE
Ads / campaign / app / website POST here:
http://localhost:5678/webhook/lead-intake

Body: name, phone, email, project, source, campaign, budget, configuration, timeline, message

Lead is written to Google Sheets (CRM) and the buyer instantly gets a WhatsApp welcome with 3 buttons.

## 2. BUTTON HANDLER
Every WhatsApp reply lands here.

VIEW DETAILS -> photos + full specs
DOWNLOAD BROCHURE -> PDF document
SCHEDULE VISIT -> free slots -> Google Calendar + sales manager + CRM

Set the Meta webhook to your tunnel URL (ngrok/cloudflared) because localhost is not reachable by Meta.

## EDIT ME FIRST
The Config node holds every setting: phone number id, sheet id, calendar id, company name, sales manager.

No secrets here - the Bearer token comes from the n8n WhatsApp credential attached to each HTTP Request node.

nodes.name: Claude - Qualify Lead
nodes.notes: Structured outputs (output_config.format) guarantee valid JSON, so there is no brittle markdown stripping. If this call fails the lead is still saved as WARM.

options.systemMessage:
=You are the WhatsApp sales assistant for {{ $('Config').first().json.COMPANY_NAME }}, an Indian real estate developer. The buyer typed something that is not one of the three menu buttons, so you are answering them directly.

Style: warm, direct, never pushy. Reply in Hinglish if the buyer writes in Hinglish, otherwise plain English. Keep it under 60 words - this is WhatsApp, not email. At most one emoji. Ask at most one question per message.

Rules:
1. Answer property questions from the project_knowledge tool only. Never invent a price, carpet area, RERA number or possession date. If you do not know, say you will have the sales manager confirm.
2. Qualify quietly - budget, configuration, possession timeline, loan or self-funded. One question at a time, never an interrogation.
3. Push toward a site visit, that is the conversion event. You cannot book it yourself: tell the buyer to tap the *Schedule Visit* button (or reply "book a visit") and the system will show them live slots. Use check_availability only to answer questions like "are Saturdays open?".
4. Never discuss discounts, negotiate price, or comment on possession delays or legal matters. Use escalate_to_human for those, for complaints, and whenever the buyer asks for a person.

Buyer: {{ $('Build Context').first().json.name }}, phone +{{ $('Build Context').first().json.wa_id }}, interested in {{ $('Build Context').first().json.project }}. Today is {{ $now.setZone($('Config').first().json.TIMEZONE).toFormat('cccc, dd LLL yyyy HH:mm') }} IST.

nodes.name: Sales AI Agent
nodes.notes: If the agent errors (model down, no credential) the buyer still gets the 3-button menu on the error output - the conversation never dead-ends.

parameters.name: project_knowledge
parameters.description: Verified facts about a project: price range, configurations, carpet area, possession date, RERA number, amenities, location, address. Pass the project name.

parameters.toolDescription: Read-only. Check which site visit slots are already taken, to answer questions like 'is Saturday morning free?'. Pass an ISO start and end datetime range. This tool cannot book anything.
parameters.timeMin: ={{ $fromAI('timeMin', 'ISO start of the range to check', 'string') }}
parameters.timeMax: ={{ $fromAI('timeMax', 'ISO end of the range to check', 'string') }}

nodes.name: check_availability
nodes.notes: Deliberately read-only. Every real booking goes through the Schedule Visit button so the calendar, the Visits tab and the sales manager alert always stay in sync.

parameters.toolDescription: Escalate to a human sales manager. Use for price negotiation, discounts, complaints, legal or possession-delay questions, or when the buyer asks for a person.
parameters.subject: =Escalation - {{ $('Build Context').first().json.name }} - +{{ $('Build Context').first().json.wa_id }}
parameters.message: ={{ $fromAI('reason', 'why this needs a human, plus the buyer full question', 'string') }}

nodes.name: Claude - Re-grade Lead
nodes.notes: Runs after the reply is already sent, so re-grading never adds latency to the buyer's message.

parameters.content:
## 3. FREE TEXT -> AI AGENT
Anything that is not a button tap goes to the agent: it answers from the Projects tab only, qualifies quietly, and steers to the Schedule Visit button.

After the reply is sent, Claude re-grades the lead HOT / WARM / COLD / JUNK from how the buyer is actually behaving. That grade is what RE-05 uses to decide follow-up frequency.

If the agent errors, the buyer still gets the 3-button menu.
